messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: kvcache-prefetch error rate spiked to 12% in prod-us-east-1, latency 99th -> 2.4s, impacted routes: /generate, /chat. Detected continuous-batching amplification pattern for qwen-mqa and llama-1 variants. Auto-pager created.

carlos (oncall): acked. I’m on it, grabbing logs and starting triage.

sam (sre): seeing similar across 3 shards. KV miss amplification + prefix card explosion. CPU on feeders climbing, evictions high.

jenna (eng-runtime): thanks — can you dump the current batching config? suspect continuous-batch window widened after yesterday’s rollout.

sam (sre): pasted logs: ```
FEEDER shard-22: prefetch_entries=1.2M, batch_window_ms=150, contbatch_load=23.7x
KV: evictions/sec=3200, hit_rate=0.48 -> 0.12
MODEL(Llama-XL): mqa_mode=enabled, kv_key_prefix_card=high
```

lydia (eng-ml): Llama-XL MQA path is known to cause prefix-cardinality blowups if prefetch thresholds are too permissive. Qwen-MQA combined with high sampling leads to multi-model cold cache storms.

carlos (oncall): customer impact? Maria, any incoming tickets?

maria (support): AcmeDocs reported timeouts for document export two minutes ago. Several API retries from our top 5 customers. I'm drafting an ETA note.

jenna (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce continuous-batch window to 20ms, 2) disable aggressive prefetching for MQA-enabled models, 3) scale out read replicas for critical KV shards. Rolling patch to runtime config in 2 mins.

ops-bot: deploy starting: config/runtime-prefetch-2026-03-15 -> prod-us-east-1 (canary: shard-22).

carlos (oncall): do canary first, leave oncall loop open. Notify product/CS.

jenna (eng-runtime): canary applied to shard-22. Monitoring.

sam (sre): post-canary metrics: contbatch_load halved on shard-22, evictions down 60%, 99p latency improved to 320ms.

lydia (eng-ml): also recommend pinning Llama-XL requests to the GQA path variant for now (gqa-stable-1) — MQA disabled until we can adjust prefetch heuristics. That will avoid mixed MQA/GQA workload oscillation.

tim (eng-infra): I can add auto-throttle rule for prefetch per-tenant; will push a conservative limit to prevent single-tenant storms.

carlos (oncall): good. After canary success roll to remaining shards with stagger 30s. Also initiate customer comms: Apology + mitigation steps. Maria can you post?

maria (support): posted customer status: "We’re investigating increased generation latency and intermittent timeouts. Engineers have deployed a configuration change and performance is improving. We will follow up with a post-incident summary."

ops-bot: deploy completed: config/runtime-prefetch-2026-03-15 -> prod-us-east-1 (rollout complete, success rate 99.4%).

sam (sre): cluster-wide: evictions normalized, KV hit-rate recovering to 0.85, request 99p near baseline. No further pager alerts.

lydia (eng-ml): follow-up: we should run a test harness with mixed MQA/GQA traffic to reproduce the edge and tune prefetch heuristics. Also schedule a model rollout to a MQA-safety variant that aborts prefetch if prefix-card grows beyond threshold.

jenna (eng-runtime): noted. I’ll open two PRs: one for the prefetch guardrail, one for batch-window tunables per model family. Link back here once created.

carlos (oncall): summary for handoff: Root cause: aggressive continuous-batch + prefetch heuristics combined with Llama-XL MQA path triggered prefix-cardinality blowup -> KV eviction storm -> latency/p50/p99 regression. Mitigation: reduced batch window, disabled aggressive prefetch for MQA, canary + rollout, tenant-level prefetch throttle. Customer impact: intermittent timeouts for several top customers (AcmeDocs cited). Next steps: postmortem, PRs for guardrails, automated test in staging, customer follow-up.

maria (support): sending update to affected customers with ETA for postmortem.

jenna (eng-runtime): commands used (for runbook): ```bash
# rollback aggressive prefetch
redwoodctl config set prefetch.aggressive=false --scope=models:*-mqa --region=prod-us-east-1
# reduce contbatch window
redwoodctl config set batching.cont_window_ms=20 --region=prod-us-east-1
# canary apply
redwoodctl deploy config/runtime-prefetch-2026-03-15 --canary-shard=22
```

carlos (oncall): adding label: INCIDENT-PRIORITY=P2, owners: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre. Handoff to evening oncall @ 2471010605. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: NOTE: incident closed to paging at 2471010605, follow-up tasks created: #INC-1428 (postmortem), #INC-1429 (test-harness), #INC-1430 (customer-comms).
